data.title: Qualcomm Launches Comprehensive Robotics Investment Initiative in Japan, Anchored by New Qualcomm Japan Robotics Center | Qualcomm
data.description: Qualcomm has launched a robotics investment initiative in Japan, anchored by the new Qualcomm Japan Robotics Center. Working with leading robotics, automation, research, and technology organizations, the initiative aims to advance an open physical AI ecosystem through innovation, ecosystem development, commercialization, and deployment, helping accelerate next-generation robotics solutions in Japan and globally.
